To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have created an atlas of human brain structure and systems that is scalable, parcellated and labeled, accurate, realistic, of sub-voxel resolution, and interactive, and we have integrated it with the previously created atlas of cerebrovascular and tracts.
we designed and developed an advanced, 3D, scalable, parcellated and labeled, accurate and realistic, interactive and reference whole human brain atlas.
we have designed a three-dimensional interactive atlas of the human brain and developed a detailed, parcellable, labeled, accurate and scalable model of the human brain.
In summary, our research is concerned with
design, development, validation, and application of an atlas of the human brain.
design and construction of a comprehensive, accurate, and scalable 3D atlas of the human brain.
design, development and validation of a three-dimensional interactive atlas of human brain structure, vasculatures and tracts.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this atlas is an important milestone in the field of brain modeling and exploration.
the atlas design, development, and implementation presented here represent a major advancement in the atlas field.
we have designed, created, and integrated a 3D, interactive, scalable, and anatomically accurate whole human brain atlas.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the human brain can be presented in 1700 2D/3D pieces and can be explored in a form of atlas with sub-voxel anatomical accuracy.
we developed a new, scalable, accurate, realistic, interactive, and 3D atlas of the human brain.

we have designed and created the most detailed and realistic 3D atlas of human brain to date, with a goal of creating a platform for a multi-level, integrated, interactive, scalable and accurate atlas of the human brain.

the design and creation of a complex 3D model is a multi-step process that requires a clear vision, a well thought-out design, and careful execution.
a detailed, interactive, and scalable atlas of structure, systems, vasculature and tractors is feasible and can be created.
a 3D, scalable, interactive, reference atlas of the human brain can be created with the design principles and methods presented in this paper.
